sentences.en: He took his daughter with him whenever he went abroad.
sentences.zh: 1. 每当他出国时都会带上女儿。

sentences.en: I found a new meaning whenever I read the book.
sentences.zh: 2. 每当我读这本书时都能发现新的意义。

sentences.en: Whenever I go by, Mt. Fuji is in the clouds.
sentences.zh: 3. 每当经过那里时，富士山都隐没在云雾中。

senses.zh: 不论何时；随便什么时候
